title: Someoneulti's Dungeons
description: A 1.20.1 forge mod that adds new dungeons and structures to your world.
body:
Adding new dungeons to explore and conquer.

Currently only has the Greater Jungle Temple. Inside you may get your hands on the new Snakefang Weapon.

Snakefang is a sword that deals stacking poison with each hit (up to poison 3) and can launch a deadly projectile

Also adds several enchantments to the game:

Toxic: Inflicts poison on hit (Not compatible with fire aspect)

Frost Aspect: Freezes mobs for a few seconds after getting hit. (Not compatible with fire aspect)

Freeze: Like frost aspect but for bows (Not compatible with flame)

Shatter: Decreases enemy armor on hit (Makes a breach sound effect, axes only, not compatible with sharpness, smite, or bane of arthropods)

Blazing: Allows you to shoot fireballs from a flint and steel with right click, with a cost of XP.

More Planned In The Future.
